This step only decides which title survives; description / cover / year automatically take whichever side has a value, and episodes are merged into multi-source by content hash — there is nothing to pick item by item.

Each merged episode keeps a "Merged from <source series> · was E<n>" provenance note, and can be renumbered or moved later in the detail view. Tags from both series are merged and deduplicated — nothing is lost, nothing duplicated.
media.seriesMergeOrderHint: Merging is fully automatic — there is no keep/delete choice to make: if both sides hold the same file (identical content hash) they are the SAME episode and get merged into one episode with multiple sources, using no new episode number; different content, or a side with no file at all, is kept separately with a new number. Title / description / cover / year take whichever side has a value — an empty value never overwrites what you already filled in.
